# Corteza

> Meetings that close the loop. Corteza makes sure every meeting ends in action: decisions stick, commitments get done, and each meeting runs better than the last.

After a meeting, Corteza follows every decision and commitment until it's done. Before a recurring meeting, it briefs attendees on what was decided and what's still open. And it gives the organizer private feedback on how the meeting went and what to improve. No bots join your meetings and nobody takes notes. Corteza is in private beta.

## Pages

- [Home](/): The problem, how Corteza closes the loop before, during and after meetings, and FAQ.
- [Early Access](/early-access): Request a spot in the private beta.
- [Blog](/blog): Articles on team memory, decision culture, and reducing repeated work.
